modalLead: More than a hundred fixes — bookmarks that landed on the wrong page, settings and backups that did not keep, automatic container updates that failed in silence — and a guide to running your self-hosted setup from nextDash.

items.text: The Disk tab shows its progress. Measuring can take a while on a large host; a progress window now says it is busy.
nextDash no longer stops itself in the middle of an update. On Unraid and some other hosts it could mistake another container for its own.
A failed automatic update tells you, and at which step. Notices from automatic updates follow the Notifications switch and your muted containers.
An update keeps every published port, and Remove stopped removes only the containers it showed you.
Moves and undos keep bookmarks on their own page, also after a reload and when the same address is saved on two pages.
Pinned bookmarks and sorted categories keep the order you gave them after a drag.
With the same address on two pages, Health and Work through act on the right one.
Saving Expectations in the Bookmarks view keeps the bookmark's sign-in.
A source no longer skips a round that failed, and no longer brings back a link you deleted.
The note editor and the cheat sheet keep their keys when opened from the command palette: Enter, the arrows and Escape no longer reach the palette behind them.
Custom widget percentages say their scale. Show as offers Percentage (0–100) and Percentage from a share (0–1), so 0.8% no longer shows as 80%.
Keep settings on this device only no longer undoes other browsers. Tag rules, saved searches and alert settings added elsewhere stay.
Backups include the images you held or skipped in Containers, and restoring the oldest automatic backup no longer deletes it.
A guide to your self-hosted setup. Help → Containers explains how containers, bookmarks, health checks and alerts work together, and Tips has a group of its own for it.
